name: Connecticut
overview: Connecticut combines an income-tax credit with separately administered homeowner and renter relief for older or disabled residents.

programs.name: Property Tax Credit against income tax
programs.incomeDefinition: Connecticut adjusted gross income and filing status determine phaseout.
programs.incomeLimits: Graduated filing-status phaseout; see 2025 property-tax-credit table.
programs.formulaSummary: Qualifying primary-residence and/or motor-vehicle taxes, capped and phased out by income; limited to income-tax liability.
eligibilityNotes: Requires Connecticut residency and qualifying taxes actually paid.
Motor-vehicle taxes are also eligible and must be separated for a housing-only comparison.
programs.programYear: 2025 taxes paid; 2025 income-tax return filed in 2026.

programs.name: Homeowners' elderly/disabled tax relief
programs.ageRule: Generally age 65+, total disability, or qualifying surviving spouse.
programs.incomeDefinition: Qualifying taxable and nontaxable income; annual OPM thresholds.
programs.incomeLimits: 2025 qualifying income no greater than $46,300 unmarried or $56,500 married.
programs.formulaSummary: Graduated income-based percentage reduction with minimum and maximum credits.
programs.application: Apply to local assessor February 1–May 15, 2026 for the 2025 Grand List; generally renew biennially.
eligibilityNotes: Principal residence and residency requirements apply.
interactions: Municipal optional relief may supplement state-law relief.
programs.programYear: 2025 program year and October 1, 2025 Grand List; uses 2025 income, with applications February 1–May 15, 2026.

programs.name: Renters' Rebate for elderly/disabled renters
programs.ageRule: Age 65+, qualifying surviving spouse age 50+, or eligible disability age 18+.
programs.incomeDefinition: Qualifying income includes taxable and nontaxable amounts, subject to statutory exclusions.
programs.formulaSummary: 35% of qualifying rent/utilities less 5% of qualifying income, subject to income-table bounds.
eligibilityNotes: One-year state residence; qualifying rent and utility payments required.
programs.programYear: 2025 rent/income claimed in 2026; payment generally by November 30.

researchNotes: Homeowner applications in February–May 2026 cover the October 1, 2025 Grand List and 2025 qualifying income.
